baseline: 服务端公式优先，用户单机设计明确覆盖破损与修理方式

sources.role: 武器、衣服与其他装备耐久损耗

adopted.zeroDurability: 装备保留在原槽，属性失效
adopted.repair: 唯一维修方式；恢复到原maxDurability，最大耐久不下降
adopted.incomingPhysicalStruckOtherSlotChance: each equipped slot independently 1/8; armor participates and may lose twice
adopted.normalRepairOil: max durability loses floor(missing raw durability / 30); restore up to 5000 raw
adopted.warGodOil: restore current raw durability to unchanged maximum raw durability

projectExtensions.policy: 与其他非衣服装备相同，在正物理StruckDamage事件中各自独立1/8损耗同一raw值
projectExtensions.reason: 项目扩展槽不伪造鞋或腰带，采用明确且可测试的统一扩展规则

explicitOverrides.server: 耐久归零清除wIndex/删除装备
普通修理按RepairItemDecDura降低最大耐久

priceStatus: StdItems.Price缺失；优先servicePrice，否则使用已标注的项目价格候选
